The IVRS mention is incidental (a patient narrative) -- reviewer to confirm.

witnesses.span: was randomized in the Interactive Voice Response System (IVRS)
The demographic and baseline characteristics were generally similar between treatment groups for the ITT population.

D2_deviations_assignment.why: Double-blind; MACE analyses in the ITT, all-as-randomised population.

witnesses.span: ELIXA was a double-blind, randomized (1:1), parallel design trial comparing lixisenatide to placebo as an add-on therapy to standard of care
The CV analyses for MACE events were based on the intent-to-treat (ITT), all patients as randomized population.

D3_missing_outcome_data.why: Vital status available for 99%; 71 lacked vital-status follow-up (42 placebo vs 29 lixisenatide).

witnesses.span: Vital status was available for 99% of the randomized subjects as shown in Section 3.3.1.5; only 71 subjects lacked vital status follow-up – 42 in the placebo group and 29 in the lixisenatide group.

D4_outcome_measurement.why: Cardiovascular adjudication committee blinded to treatment assignment.

witnesses.span: These cardiovascular events were adjudicated by a cardiovascular adjudication committee (CAC) blinded to treatment assignment.

D5_selection_of_reported_result.why: PRESPECIFICATION DISPUTE, three sources quoted: (1) the FDA STATISTICAL review lists 'time to first secondary MACE event (CV death, non-fatal MI and non-fatal stroke)' as one of two secondary endpoints and calls its Cox analysis 'pre-specified'; (2) the FDA SUMMARY review of the same NDA calls the three-component MACE a SENSITIVITY analysis; (3) the REGISTRY (NCT01147250) registers the 4-point MACE+ as primary and, as secondary outcomes, only a 5-point composite (+HF hospitalisation), a 6-point composite (+revascularisation) and UACR -- the 3-point composite is registered as neither. No dated SAP is held. The sources disagree on whether the reported 3-point result was a prespecified endpoint, so 5.1 cannot be answered yes. (Eligibility for the pool is unaffected: B-prime admits the exact three components, prospectively adjudicated.)

witnesses.span: In addition to the primary MACE+ endpoint, two secondary endpoints – time to first secondary MACE event (defined as CV death, non-fatal MI and non- fatal stroke) and time to all-cause mortality – were also evaluated.

There were 792 secondary MACE events observed in the study for the ITT population, 400 in the lixisenatide group and 392 in the placebo group. The pre-specified Cox proportional hazards analysis resulted in a hazard ratio estimate of 1.02
Sensitivity analyses relying on the three component MACE endpoint (CV-death, non-fatal MI and non-fatal stroke) or only “on-treatment” MACE+ were consistent with the results of the primary analysis.
PROTOCOL PRIMARY OUTCOME: Time to First Occurence of Primary CV Event: CV Death, Non-Fatal MI, Non-Fatal Stroke or Hospitalization for Unstable Angina
RESULT OUTCOME 1 [SECONDARY]: Time to First Occurence of CV Event: CV Death, Non-Fatal MI, Non-Fatal Stroke, Hospitalization for Unstable Angina or Hospitalization For Heart Failure

RESULT OUTCOME 2 [SECONDARY]: Time to First Occurence of CV Event: CV Death, Non-Fatal MI, Non-Fatal Stroke, Hospitalization for Unstable Angina, Hospitalization For Heart Failure or Coronary Revascularization Procedure
RESULT OUTCOME 3 [SECONDARY]: Percent Change From Baseline in the Urinary Albumin/Creatinine Ratio (UACR) at Week 108

witnesses.span: While more subjects discontinued in the lixisenatide arms earlier in the study, exposures were overall balanced.
